metadata.title: Rational-point undecidability for smooth projective varieties over the rational numbers
metadata.description: Combining OpenAI's negative solution of rational Hilbert's tenth problem, with two explicit proof corrections documented in the verification package, and Poonen's established effective transfer, this note proves undecidability of rational-point existence for arbitrary smooth projective geometrically integral varieties over Q. It specifies homogeneous-equation presentations and valid-input oracle use, and rules out a computable uniform bound on the height of one point in terms of presentation size. Dimension and all size parameters may vary. The arithmetic breakthrough is attributed to OpenAI and the geometric reduction to Poonen; no independent solution of rational Hilbert's tenth problem, new geometric reduction, fixed-dimensional theorem, many-one hardness or first-priority claim is made. AI tools were used extensively in research, drafting and adversarial verification. The preprint has not undergone conventional human peer review or refereeing at publication; no complete formal verification is claimed. The standalone height supplement explicitly states its retained geometric inputs.
